Keep confirmed-only resubscription, consent and opt-out precedence, suppression, exact-revision approval and uncertain-handoff fences intact. publicReleaseNotes: Mango 0.3.0 (19 October 2026) adds operator roles (Owner, Admin, Manager, Author, Analyst, Support), pause and resume for scheduled campaigns, duplicating campaigns and templates, follow-ups to non-clickers, tests to typed addresses with a daily allowance, pre-send advisories and sent-size checks, a contact timeline, per-link clicks and recipients per outcome, a mailbox-provider breakdown, a public web archive of sent letters with RSS, kiosk signup for events, confirmation-only resubscription and scoped integration credentials. Restore now verifies the whole archive first, and HTTP restore clients must send archiveHash. Back up first: 19 additive migrations (0058-0076) apply in filename order and a 0.2.0 install keeps all its data. The homepage's "team of equals" line predates roles; new operators start as Admin. Hosted backup and restore are not built in, and Delivered, bounce and complaint reports need a SendGrid signed Event Webhook. Product screenshot: .github/assets/release/mango-contact-ledger-1600.png
